claude-fable-5-1: The cost formula subtracts a flat 6 for any `added:`/`removed:` line (diff.patch:L613), but directional() turns `+ ` (2 chars) into `added: ` (7 chars, +5) and `- ` into `removed: ` (9 chars, +7) (diff.patch:L582-L583); versus the base cost of line.length + 3 (base/src/graph/codeEvidence.ts:L180, L208), an added line now costs one less and a removed line one more, so neither label retains the previous cost. The flag's aside that the added label preserves the old cost is itself off by one, but the statement remains contradicted; the agent's edit introduced the comment and the 6 together with no arithmetic (raw/agent-a4a94ea89d7a98bce.jsonl:L251), and the only code-cell test uses a 2000-char budget (diff.patch:L998). | gpt-6-astra: Costs are not preserved: the six-character discount leaves short removal candidates one character more expensive and addition candidates one cheaper.
